sources.entry: devpi - PyPI server and packaging/testing/release tool.

summary.one_liner: devpi is a PyPI-compatible package index server plus client tooling for packaging, testing, and releasing Python packages.
summary.what_it_does: The repository holds three packages that make up the devpi system. devpi-server serves a pypi.org-consistent caching index and user or team-based indexes that can inherit packages from each other or from pypi.org. devpi-web is a plugin for devpi-server that adds a web and search interface. devpi-client is a command line tool with subcommands for creating users, using indexes, uploading to and installing from indexes, and a "test" command that invokes tox. The README is brief and mostly points to external documentation for getting started.
use_cases: host a private PyPI index for a team
upload and install internal Python packages
run tox tests through a devpi index
browse and search hosted Python packages in a web UI
notable: Index inheritance: user or team indexes can inherit packages from other indexes or from pypi.org
Caching mirror of pypi.org for user or team indexes
Optional web and search interface via devpi-web plugin
Client CLI includes a test command that invokes tox
caveats: README gives no install or run commands; getting-started steps are in external docs
Paid support and help are offered by the maintainers (contact for support contracts)
keywords: share python packages with my team
